findings.rule: .nunnarivu/skills/isolate/SKILL.md step 3 ("Later stations touch nothing outside it") and .nunnarivu/skills/build/SKILL.md step 3 ("When a change outside the write set is unavoidable, do not make it: write what is missing under a `## Notes` section of nunnarivu/wp-<issue>/package.md")
findings.evidence: nunnarivu/wp-3/package.md:16-20 declares the write set as `python/src/pager/cli.py`, `python/tests/test_pager.py` and `nunnarivu/wp-3/`; `git show --stat 0c7c3f0` lists `scripts/test-scoped.sh | 5 +++++`, and scripts/test-scoped.sh:24-28 adds the comment and `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`; package.md has no `## Notes` section. The change itself is well founded (reproduced in a scratch copy: with the head cli.py compiled first, then the base cli.py written with the same 749-byte size and the same mtime second, `pytest -k rejects_non_positive` still passes on the base source because the stale cli.cpython-311.pyc is taken as fresh; with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 from a clean tree it passes on head and fails on base), but scripts/ is outside the package's claimed write set and no other package's claim protects it.
findings.fix: Restore scripts/test-scoped.sh to the base commit (6a4dc46) and add a `## Notes` section to nunnarivu/wp-3/package.md stating that the evidence check needs `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` in scripts/test-scoped.sh before its pytest run (the base and fixed cli.py have the same size, so a .pyc written by the first run masks the restored source when both writes land in the same second), for the owner or a package whose write set includes scripts/ to make; then rerun `node .nunnarivu/bin/nunnarivu evidence check`.

findings.rule: .nunnarivu/skills/prove/SKILL.md step 3 ("implementation: every non-test file this package changed, except files under nunnarivu/wp-<issue>/ ... Every changed file goes in exactly one of the two lists") and .nunnarivu/skills/fix/SKILL.md step 4
findings.evidence: `git diff --stat 6a4dc46..0c7c3f0` lists scripts/test-scoped.sh among the changed files, but nunnarivu/wp-3/evidence.json:8-10 lists only `python/src/pager/cli.py` under implementation.
findings.fix: If scripts/test-scoped.sh is reverted per the write-set finding, nothing more is needed; otherwise add "scripts/test-scoped.sh" to the implementation list and rerun `node .nunnarivu/bin/nunnarivu evidence check`.
